grh_31ceb176841497654d0b.title: The Submarine Caves
paragraphs: On the Channel Island of Garth, Holmes uncovers a plan by domineering Mrs. Reeves and her German doctor, Uberbach, to remove the island's elderly ruler and steer the strategically placed island toward Germany as a submarine base. Reeves strands Holmes in tidal caves to keep him from proving that the old woman was poisoned, but Holmes has deliberately lied that the chemical test will become useless after twenty-four hours; while Reeves detains him, Watson performs the real test. Confronted by the new seigneur Christopher with proof of murder and treason, Reeves leaps from a balcony to her death, and Holmes orders that Uberbach be prevented from escaping. Garth remains British.

The surviving recording runs about 30 minutes. The broadcast is also associated with [[org|org.bbd501bf461d302b|Petri Wines]] and [[org|org.bbd501bf461d302b|Petri Wines]].
This version is based on [[work|work.doyle.5c9181025b12dd1a|The Adventure of the Bruce-Partington Plans]]. Arthur Conan Doyle is credited as author.

grh_3198ce71099c2197817e.title: Ace-in-the-hole
paragraphs: Newly released prisoner Zeb Hamilton is trying to start over when a lame horse leads him to the isolated Jamison farm. His former gang leader Kurt Fanner has escaped and followed Zeb to recover money they buried after the robbery that sent them both to prison, trapping Zeb, Wilbur Jamison and Wilbur's niece Marcy under gunfire. Zeb and Marcy fall in love while trying to survive, and Fanner is finally stopped. The danger is not over when a lawman decides to steal the recovered money and eliminate the witnesses, but the scheme fails; Zeb returns the money to the bank and decides that Marcy, not the hidden cash, is his real ace in the hole.

grh_31abd6c7a10683ffb936.title: Bruja
paragraphs: Young Dolores wants a modern life of college, dancing and friends, not the destiny her family says was chosen for her by an old shaman and the Jaguar warrior tradition. Her great-aunt Dona Lola begins teaching her the ancient practices of a bruja, and strange encounters gradually convince Dolores that the powers are real. Rival warlocks move to destroy her before those abilities fully mature. When they attack, Dolores relies on the lesson that harming another is ultimately harming oneself, and the violence turns back on the attackers, forcing her to accept that the old tradition she resisted is now part of her life.

grh_319ed8d5c1c7d90fd4a8.title: Sweethearts
paragraphs: Franz, crown prince of Zelenia, falls in love with laundry worker Sylvia, who turns him down after learning his true rank because she believes a common girl cannot marry a prince. A family secret then reveals that Sylvia was adopted and is herself the missing heir to Zelenia's throne. grh_31620911d3ba45b7482a.title: The New Adventures of Sherlock Holmes-The Paradol Chamber
